# Miss Barry

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P91](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0091), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P94](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0094), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P17](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0017)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Diana](../character/diana.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Miss Barry is an old woman with a wrinkled cheek. Even in her advanced age, her sharp black eyes remain bright and undimmed.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P17](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008)_

## Personality

Miss Barry is an elderly woman who has historically exhibited a self-centered nature, rarely caring for others. Despite her selfish tendencies, she is known to be a remarkably gracious host who treats her guests with great hospitality.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P26](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)_

- selfish  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)</sub>

## History

Miss Barry was a selfish old lady who previously cared little for anyone besides herself. While visiting Diana's home, her sleep was unexpectedly interrupted when [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) jumped onto her bed, leaving her furious and threatening to cancel Diana's music lessons until [Anne](../character/anne.md) apologized. Later, she entertained [Anne](../character/anne.md) during her weekend visits to [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) while [Anne](../character/anne.md) attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). Eventually, her expensive twenty-dollar willowware platter was accidentally smashed at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) during a chaotic day when a planned guest failed to arrive.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P2](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. ## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--miss-barry.md)

Miss Barry first encountered [Anne](../character/anne.md) under unfavorable circumstances when [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally jumped on her in a spare-room bed, causing immense fury. However, after [Anne](../character/anne.md) personally apologized to make amends, Miss Barry grew fond of her, eventually hosting [Anne](../character/anne.md) at her [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) home during her studies and expressing deep pride in Anne's academic achievements. Though their interactions are generally warm, occasional mishaps still occur, such as when Miss Barry's expensive platter was accidentally smashed during a disastrous dinner party [Anne](../character/anne.md) hosted.

- Friend of — expresses deep pride in her achievements  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P13](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P16](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0016), +1 more</sub>

### [Diana](../character/diana.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana--miss-barry.md)

Miss Barry is Diana's great-aunt. Their relationship faced early strain when an unexpected late-night prank by [Diana](../character/diana.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) ended with them leaping onto Miss Barry in bed, prompting the elder woman to threaten to cancel Diana's music lessons. Despite this rocky incident, Miss Barry remains an influential relative who provides hospitality, hosting [Anne](../character/anne.md) and maintaining ties with [Diana](../character/diana.md) as the girls grow up.

- Relative of — aunt  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P23](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0023)</sub>
